extension.news: 6.9.3.1: fixed a real, confirmed-live bug - the main service loop recreated a full xbmcaddon.Addon() object every single poll cycle (every 4s, forever) purely to check the addon hadn't been uninstalled mid-run. Because this addon's settings.xml is still in the legacy pre-Kodi18 flat format, every one of those re-creations forced Kodi to fully reparse the old-format settings definitions (visible as repeated "CAddonSettings: trying to load setting definitions from old format..." log spam, ~700 failed label lookups per cycle). This was a genuine continuous CPU/log-I/O drain running for as long as the box was on, confirmed via live log analysis and fixed by replacing the per-cycle Addon() recreation with the same cheap file-existence check (connect.py presence) already used elsewhere in this same file for the same purpose. VPN functionality itself is untouched. Forked from upstream 6.9.3 solely to carry this one-line fix; id changed from service.vpn.manager to avoid colliding with the real upstream addon if that's ever installed from its own repository too.
extension.summary: Configure and manage VPN connections using openVPN (DC Fix - stops a continuous settings-reparse loop)
extension.description: Establish a connection to a VPN service and automatically switch VPN locations based on the add-on being used. This is a minimally patched fork of Zomboided's VPN Manager for OpenVPN (service.vpn.manager) - see https://github.com/Zomboided/service.vpn.manager for the original and full documentation. The only change is a one-line fix to stop the background service from reparsing its own legacy-format settings.xml every 4 seconds forever (see changelog).
